Profile Levosimendan is a cardiac inotrope and vasodilator with calci- um-sensitising properties, used in the management of acute heart failure (p.1165). It is given intravenously in a loading dose of 6 to 24 micrograms/kg over 10 minutes followed by a continuous infusion of 50 to 200 nanograms/kg per minute, adjusted accord- ing to response. ◊ References. 1.
